name: holly-for-home-assistant
description: Unofficial assistant for a Home Assistant instance. Connects the built-in MCP server, then helps with safe updates, repairs, cleanup, automations, dashboards, and themes. Not affiliated with Home Assistant or the Open Home Foundation.

HA_URL.title: Instance URL
HA_URL.description: Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, with no path and no token. You set this in the plugin configuration. Example shape: https://home.example

HA_TOKEN.title: Long-lived access token
HA_TOKEN.description: Secret. Long-lived access token for the MCP server. Enter it in the secure secret field. Never paste it into chat.
